turns.answer:
The Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 or Vol. 2 is the safest choice if your main concern is the wallet sliding off in your pocket.

Here's the important distinction:

Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1: The wallet is built into the case, so it cannot detach. No magnet needed.

Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 2: Also has integrated card storage, so there's no magnetic wallet to slide off.

ESR Geo Wallet Boost: Uses MagSafe magnets to attach to your phone. It's convenient and removable, but it can potentially shift or detach when caught against tight clothing.

If you specifically want a detachable MagSafe wallet with the strongest possible magnetic grip, that's a different comparison.

Shop

ESR Geo Wallet Boost

$36.99 · Strongest magnet among the three options

ESR specifies 1,800 g of magnetic holding force. A hands-on reviewer also reported that it stays attached when pulled in and out of tight pockets. 
ESR
+1

View at ESR

One important detail: the strength of the MagSafe case underneath matters too. A strong wallet paired with a weak magnetic case can still slide.

Are you planning to use the wallet on a bare iPhone or on a MagSafe case? That will affect which setup I recommend.

turns.prompt: How much weight does a wallet case add to the phone?
turns.answer:
A wallet case typically adds 40–100 grams (1.4–3.5 oz) to an iPhone, depending on the design and how many cards you carry.

Here's a comparison of the options we discussed:

Wallet case

	

Estimated added weight




Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1

	

40–60 g




Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 2

	

50–75 g




ESR Geo Wallet Boost (wallet only)

	

70–90 g




ESR + protective MagSafe case

	

100–130 g

These are approximate ranges, not verified model-specific specifications.

What about the weight of your cards?

Each credit card weighs approximately 5 g.

Three cards add around 15 g.

Five cards add around 25 g.

My recommendation

If you want a lightweight wallet case that won't detach in your pocket, the Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 is probably your best option.

If you prefer a detachable MagSafe wallet, expect more weight, especially when you include the protective case.

turns.prompt: Which one would you pick if you were me?
turns.answer:
I'd pick the Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1 for iPhone 18 Pro.

Based on what you've told me, your priorities seem to be:

Secure wallet: You don't want it sliding off in your pocket.

Low weight: You don't want to make your phone unnecessarily heavy.

Good fit: You need something designed for the iPhone 18 Pro.

Shop

Smartish Wallet Slayer Vol. 1

The integrated card holder solves your biggest concern: there's no detachable wallet to fall off.

It's also a simpler, potentially lighter setup than combining a protective case with a separate MagSafe wallet.

The one drawback: You give up MagSafe wireless charging with the wallet case.

If wireless charging isn't important to you, I'd choose the Vol. 1 over the Vol. 2 or ESR.

One thing I'd verify before ordering is the exact iPhone 18 Pro compatibility and availability.

One question: Do you regularly use MagSafe charging? That is the main thing that could change my recommendation.
